newsitem.title: USA: BRISTOL-MYERS GETS RIGHTS TO COMPOUNDS.
newsitem.headline: BRISTOL-MYERS GETS RIGHTS TO COMPOUNDS.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Wednesday that it has an agreement to obtain exclusive rights to two new anticancer compounds currently in early-stage clinical trials from Taiho Pharmaceutical Co Ltd.

According to the terms of the agreements, Bristol-Myers will obtain exclusive worldwide development and marketing rights for both compounds excluding Japan for one and Japan and South Korea for the other.
Bristol-Myers said that one compound is an oral fluoropyrimidine which has shown promise in the treatment of solid tumors, especially gastric cancer, in Phase II clinical trials in Japan.
The other compound is a novel, dual topoisomerase I/II inhibitor with a broad spectrum of antitumor activity and is currently in Phase I clinical trials in the U.S.
Milestone payments to Taiho will be related to certain stages of development for both compounds.
Taiho Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is an Otsuka Group company, based in Tokyo.
